judgments.label: uncertain
judgments.rationale: Teaser photo for the Swannington path story: the crop shows a 'Welcome to Stokeswood Park' sign by a fence and a field; the alt is the story's headline, word for word. The image sits in its own div in a teaser card; it is not inside a link, and the same headline follows it as the h3 text of the card's link. Live HTML fetched on 2026-11-21 serves the same img with the same alt and src, and the screenshot shows the card styled as captured, so captureDiffers is no. claimTrue: the alt speaks of a collapsed path reopening after works, which the photo does not show, and it leaves out what the photo does show (the park and the sign's text). elementFails: my reading is yes, since the alt is no alternative for this image: if the photo is informative it should say what it shows, and if it is decorative next to the headline it should be null; the headline repeated conveys none of the picture.
